levels.surface: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ

notes: «أَبِي» alone is a relation with no name given (rule 7)
«الثِّقَةُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا» names no one: unnamed (rule 8)
«أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ» makes the Imam the last link, as he speaks in the words after the chain (owner ruling 2); the blessing is not in the surface
